channel.title: Wildcard Watch: Ahsay
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving Ahsay, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Patch: AhsayCBS: 2 flaws exploited together
item.description:
AhsayCBS: Authentication bypass · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 9.15.2.70, 10.3.4.45

First step: Update AhsayCBS to 9.15.2.70 or 10.3.4.45 or later.

Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-105133, CVE-2026-105134
